title: Disk Space & Quota Exceeded
description: Fix sites down or failing updates due to full disk, inode exhaustion, or oversized log and backup files.

steps.title: Confirm Disk or Inode Exhaustion
steps.instructions: Check hosting panel for disk usage and inode count. Symptoms: failed uploads, failed updates, database write errors, and email failures.

steps.title: Identify Largest Files and Directories
steps.instructions: Use host file manager or SSH du -sh to find largest dirs. Common culprits: wp-content/uploads, backup folders, debug.log, and cache directories.

steps.title: Remove Old Backup Files
steps.instructions: Delete stale UpdraftPlus, BackupBuddy, or host backup archives stored on-server. Move backups to off-site storage (S3, Google Drive) going forward.

steps.title: Truncate or Rotate Large Log Files
steps.instructions: Empty oversized debug.log, error logs, and plugin log files. Disable WP_DEBUG_LOG on production or set up log rotation.

steps.title: Clean Database Bloat
steps.instructions: Remove post revisions, spam comments, expired transients, and orphaned tables from deactivated plugins. Run database cleanup on staging first.

steps.title: Audit and Remove Unused Media
steps.instructions: Delete unreferenced uploads if safe. Compress or offload large media to CDN/S3. Remove unused image sizes after thumbnail audit.

steps.title: Set Up Monitoring and Off-Site Backups
steps.instructions: Configure disk usage alerts in hosting panel. Store backups off-server only. Schedule monthly cleanup in maintenance routine.

steps.title: Verify Site Functions After Cleanup
steps.instructions: Test uploads, plugin updates, and backup jobs. Confirm adequate free space (at least 20% buffer) remains.
